comments.body:
Closing: this alarm was fired on purpose to prove the monitor works.

The URL in the table, `/artikel/idea-dan-nasihat/risk-05-probe-2026-08-27`, is a
fabricated path. It 404s, so Google has never seen it and never will — which is
exactly what makes it a fair test of "unknown to Google". The four URLs that were
genuinely unknown yesterday morning all left that state within eight hours of
RISK-04 shipping, so there was no naturally dark URL left to point at.

It was injected with `workflow_dispatch`'s `probe_url` input at the sitemap
boundary, so it travelled the identical code path a real dark URL takes:
inspection, grace window, assessment, issue body. No special-case branch.

What this run measured, rather than asserted:

- detected at `2026-08-26T17:46:55.678Z`, issue created at `2026-08-26T17:46:56Z` — a
  gap of **1s** against the 10s bar. The job fails itself if that gap exceeds 10s.
- 93 URLs swept, 0 not answered by Google.
- the sweep was archived to `s3://hellokahwin-assets/indexing-monitor/2026/08/26/sweep-20260826T174656Z.json`.

The follow-up run (32996238991) then downloaded the ledger back from R2, loaded 91
URLs, and reported `alarm=false` — confirming the probe was kept out of the
persisted state and will not alarm again tomorrow.
